title: Goldfish in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water glow behind fish -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='44' ry='32' fill='#1b4f6b'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 58 Q8 42 6 30 Q18 40 26 46 Q16 34 16 22 Q26 34 33 48 Z' fill='#ff8a1e'/>
  <path d='M22 60 Q8 76 6 88 Q18 78 26 72 Q16 84 16 96 Q26 84 33 70 Z' fill='#ff8a1e'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='58' rx='30' ry='21' fill='#ffb133'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='68' rx='22' ry='9' fill='#ffd27a'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M42 38 Q52 24 66 36 Q56 34 48 42 Z' fill='#ff8a1e'/>
  <!-- side fin -->
  <path d='M46 62 Q52 74 62 72 Q54 66 52 60 Z' fill='#ff7a10'/>
  <!-- scales -->
  <path d='M44 50 q4 4 8 0 M54 46 q4 4 8 0 M50 58 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#e06a00' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='52' r='5.5' fill='#fff8e8'/>
  <circle cx='73.5' cy='52' r='2.6' fill='#20313f'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='50.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M80 62 q3 2 1 4' stroke='#e06a00' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf wrap -->
  <path d='M34 66 Q44 76 58 72 L60 80 Q44 86 32 76 Z' fill='#e8334a'/>
  <!-- scarf knot -->
  <path d='M60 72 q6 2 6 8 q-6 0 -8 -4 Z' fill='#ff5c70'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M62 78 q10 6 12 18 q-8 -2 -12 -10 q-2 6 -8 8 q4 -10 8 -16 Z' fill='#e8334a'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d='M38 70 q4 4 10 4 M44 76 q4 4 10 2' stroke='#ffd27a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='40' r='3' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='30' r='2' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
</svg>
